item.title: Unkept planters area side of road outside erith library, 29th July
item.description:
The new flower beds on the newly laid road outside erith library and college on walnut tree road have not been planted since the road was completed and appear not to be maintained. the weeds are now about 4 foot height. It appears the other flower beds at the bottom of this hill walnut tree Road outside the college have been planted and are being maintained. Has anyone been instructed to plant dnd manage these in maintained plant beds or should they be filled with material and plant that need no maintenance to save council money. Also the fish roundabout at the top of walnut road has litter on all verges and the verges are not maintained perhaps again would need to be changed from the current grass and weeds to a non maintenance materials which would look better and require minimal maintenance and cost less. please arrange for an inspection of this area as very unsightly for all residents and visitors to this area
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Walnut Tree Road, Northumberland Heath, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet

On 21/07/26 i was travelling on the A13 eastbound (co-ordinates above) and when going over the ridge, my windscreen has cracked.
